confidencePreference.LOW: No LOW annotations exist in frozen gold.
confidencePreference.MEDIUM: Prefer 1 Development / 1 Holdout only when compatible with higher-ranked objectives and leakage constraints.

deterministicAlgorithmDescription: Build exact leakage groups by union over the four declared identities. Enumerate deterministic seeded candidates under exact group integrity and exact family quotas; retain candidates with minimal global annotation-status absolute deviation; then select the candidate minimizing the count of represented primary areas with support >= 2 absent from either split, then maximizing split coverage, then preferring one MEDIUM case in each split. Candidate generation, local improvements, and final selection use SHA-256 seed-derived ordering only; no system outputs or source text are read.
leakageGroupingRules: same normalized absolute sourcePdfPath canonical identity
same SHA-256 of NFKC/casefold/whitespace-normalized curricular source fields
same pre-existing sampling-frame groupId as known duplicate-document group

primaryAreaRepresentationPolicy.optimizationMeasure: Minimize unsupported cross-split primary-area representations after family and status objectives.
primaryAreaRepresentationPolicy.supportAtLeast3: Prefer at least one case in each split.

tieBreakRule: Among equal objective vectors, choose the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 of seed + newline-joined sorted holdout leakageGroupIds.
